title: Acme Fit: watch, phone and web mockups
subtitle: Mockups of the Acme Fit activity tracker on a round watch, a phone and the web. Comment on any screen, then approve the design or request changes.
changes: New: the phone app after sign-in. *Today* is the hub; its tab bar reaches *Activity*, *Workouts* and *Profile*, and **Start workout** opens *Workout*. *Profile* opens *Settings* as a sheet.
The screens are linked: the board draws each tap as an arrow, and **Present** follows them. Both sign-ins land on *Today* and clear the back stack.
New: the *App icon*, the Acme Fit mark (a step ring around a pulse) on teal, with its one-colour layer for tinted and themed icons.
tldr: Acme Fit on a round watch, a linked seven-screen phone app and the web dashboard, plus its app icon. Press Present to tap through the phone flow from sign-in, comment on any screen or arrow, then approve.

sections.title: Brief
sections.lead: Acme Fit tracks steps, workouts and heart rate; these screens set its look before the apps are built.

blocks.md:
- **Watch:** a round face readable at a glance, on a black background to save power.
- **Phone:** sign-in, then the daily hub and its tabs: the screens every member opens.
- **Web:** the weekly dashboard coaches and members open on a laptop.
- **App icon:** one mark for the home screens of iOS and Android.

items.text: Pick the framework for the web dashboard
items.sub: Recommend HorizonUI: it ships with bluedoc, so the dashboard renders with nothing to install.
items.detail: Acme Fit has no web or app code yet, so there is no framework of its own to match. For a new product the usual pick is Tailwind with HeroUI, on the web and on the phone. To mock up with it, run `serve.py add-framework heroui` once and ask me to switch the screens to it.

items.sub: Recommend Indigo: its accent reads on the watch's black and on the dashboard's white.
Recommend passkey first: one tap on a phone that already has a passkey, email stays one step away.
